propositions: A store-wide compaction sweep executes one `git log --full-history` walk per ticket while holding the store write lock, causing multi-minute stalls on concurrent writers; the lock should be released before history walks begin.

The authorship ledger is built by calling `build_ticket_position_commit_map` once per ticket inside the locked section; this must be replaced with a single prebuilt position-keyed map queried per ticket outside the lock.
`_commit_backfill` uses unscoped `git add -A` staging, allowing concurrent writer in-flight event files to be committed under the compaction message; staging must be scoped to folded paths only.

The sweep never re-probes `write_lock_is_busy` mid-run between tickets, so writers that arrive after the sweep starts wait for the entire run; re-probing must occur in `compact_all_cli`'s per-ticket loop.
A changed event set between ledger prep and locked re-check indicates staleness; the fold must be aborted cleanly with no SNAPSHOT written and events left live for the next pass.
The map parameter must be optional (keyword, default `None`) to preserve existing call sites in `compact_rebuild.py` and tests without changing their behaviour.
